incident.what: The ledger code was upgraded to a new schema version. Existing rounds were not migrated. The validator crashed on every old round and the agent lost the ability to append.
incident.signal: Crash on first append after the upgrade.

root_cause: An upgrade was treated as a code change only. Existing data is part of the upgrade.

law.text: An upgrade is three things done together or not at all: new code, migration of existing records, and a fail-fast check that refuses to run if any record is on the old shape.
checks: after upgrade: verify walks the whole chain and passes
a migration script exists and was run on the live ledger, not only on a fixture
the validator refuses (exit non-zero) rather than skipping records it cannot parse

notes: De-identified from a real operating incident. Names, systems and paths removed; the mechanism is kept.
